name: Genie Fight Simulator
desc:
New Update(V0.03):
 🏹   weapon system is ready 
 🎁  Massive benefits are waiting for you to receive   
 💥  More gennie & evolution state 
 📘  The atlas system  unlocked
 📈  Add leaderboards so that you can see the progress of the other players

Welcome to Genie Fight!
This is a game that you can fight with genies.
Let’s become an excellent genie trainer.
Trying to collect all kinds of genies and to evolve your genies, it makes them more powerful and new appearances of genies.
To challenge the BOSS which’s around the world.
Collecting machine parts to strengthen your firearms, that can makes easier for you to hunt the genies.

We hope you can provide some feedbacks of bug in social link or offer some suggestions directly. 

If you enjoy our game,  please don't forget to hit the like button!
Your passion is the driving force for our update.
